title: Supabase footer
description: A long, light developer footer: a centred trust row (an ink lead, a green link, three checked compliance badges) over a hairline that fades out at both ends; then the large wordmark, a row of social icons and a small newsletter form on the left beside six columns of grey 14px links under ink titles; a bottom bar with the copyright and a small icon. Phones stack the left column over two-up link columns.
notes: links darken to ink on hover (150ms)
the trust badges' notes are hidden on phones, as on the original
name: supabase-footer

props.name: logo
props.description: the wordmark, shown large at the top left

props.name: trust
props.type: { lead: string; link?: { label: string; href: string; }; badges: { name: string; note?: string; }[]; } | undefined
props.description: the trust row above the footer: an ink lead, a green link and checked badges

props.type: { label: string; icon: ReactNode; href: string; }[]

props.name: columns
props.description: the link columns: six sit in a row on desktop, two per row on phones

props.name: copyright
